title: Factory Droid client <-> daemon protocol (shared)
description: Schemas both protocol peers embed: the JSON-RPC envelope, model catalog, settings, session records and tool shapes. Referenced by droid.schema.json and daemon.schema.json. Generated from the Zod schemas in @factory/droid-sdk-core. Every distinct protocol schema is a definition, named after its most upstream export; reference one with #/definitions/<Name>. Request definitions carry x-factory-response (and/or x-factory-result) naming their response definition. Wire frames are expressed as allOf: [{$ref: JsonRpcEnvelopeSchema}, {frame-specific properties}]. Values marked x-factory-runtime-only are validated more strictly at runtime than this document can express.

fileEditToolProfile.description: Optional file-tool override for exceptional model harnesses. Use "apply-patch" to advertise ApplyPatch or "create-edit" to advertise Create and Edit. This setting takes precedence over registry overrides, registry provider identity, and GPT/Codex/o-series name inference.
